_readme: Mode profile for DUET mode: the two robots trade PRE-RENDERED lines (data/prerendered/duet/, rendered offline by scripts/render_duet.py from the two cards). No microphone is open anywhere — the console forces the floor to `none` and refuses any floor request; nothing is composed live on either robot (the voice app refuses turns in duet). Runs with zero network. Values here are the base of the resolution order: mode profile -> systemd drop-in -> app/.env -> console override.
host_intro_text: Good day. Please enjoy a short exchange between Chief Justice Panganiban and myself.

event._note: Same as kiosk; the speech settings are inert in duet because no mic opens, but they are kept so switching to direct carries the event thresholds.

playback.note: exchanges alternate Host/Panganiban lines; the console cues them (step 5)
